presentation.label: Skin lesion
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about the lump and when it started.  It may be useful to say if it is painful or itchy, if it is bleeding or crusty, whether it is growing or changing, and also whether there is a history of skin cancers.

questions.question: Have you noticed a new skin lesion or mark?
Has the lesion changed in size, shape, or colour?
Is the lesion painful, bleeding, or not healing?
